book.name: Yohanes
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I YOHANES

content: Yesus tia utus-Na
Noko daa iya'a ai Yesus nomae'mo longkop Galilea. Ia kunda dumodongo na Yudea, gause isian moomoola'na Yahudi momoosarak bo mampapatei i Ia.
Tempo iya'a karani'mo rameanna samba Yahudi men ngaanon ramean Sa'up Roon.
Mbaka' utus ni Yesus norobumo na Ko'ona taena, “Ringkatmo i Koo mae' na Yudea, kada' muriit sida uga' mimiile' upa men wawauoon.
Gause sianta sa'angu'po mian men mansapitkon mangawawau upa-upa, kalu ia mingkira' tolele na mian biai'. Kalu i Koo mangawawau upa-upa tiodaa pipiile'konoon na mian na tano' balaki'.”
(Mbali' utus-Na mangaan koiya'a gause raaya'apo uga' sian parasaya na Ko'ona.)
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Koini'i koo'po tempong-Ku, kasee i kuu daa sinampang tempoan.
Dunia kani'i sian mangka'idek i kuu, kasee mangka'idek i Yaku', montookon i Yaku' nompopo'inti'ikon se' wawauna dunia kani'i ba'idek.
Rae'mo i kuu na ramean iya'a! Yaku' sianpo mae', gause koini'i koo'po tempong-Ku.”
Koiya'a ninsimbati ni Yesus i raaya'a, ka' i Ia dauga' na Galilea.
Yesus mae' na ramean Sa'up Roon
Sarataa utus ni Yesus nomae' na ramean iya'a, Ia uga' nomae'mo kasee wuni-wuni ka' sianta paraa nintipiile' na mian.
Na ramean iya'a moomoola'na Yahudi nansarak i Yesus. Raaya'a nimikirawar na mian, taena, “Aana i Ia?”
Ka' biai' a mian pooseasoi muntundun i Ia. Isian mian men mangaan: “Ia mian ma'amat.” Isian uga' men mangaan: “Sian, Ia mantarai pisiso' sala' na mian biai'.”
Kasee sianta sa'angu'po mian men morobu rongor-rongor moomoola'na Yahudi gause layaonkon i raaya'a.
Yesus nuntundun waka-Na
Pintanga' ramean iya'a, Yesus ninsoopmo na Laiganna Alaata'ala ka' nimisiso' mian.
Mbaka' moomoola'na Yahudi nosamba'mo ka' norobu taena i raya'a, “Koi upa a mian kaya'a se' biai' a inti'ion-Na, kasee sianta nosikola?”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Pisiso'-Ku taasi' norumingkat na Ingku', kasee na Ko'ona men nomosuu' i Yaku'.
Mian men mingilimang pingkira'na Alaata'ala, sabole bo minginti'i se' pisiso'-Ku norumingkat na Alaata'ala kabai se' tongko' na Ingku'.
Mian men muntundun wakana, ia mansarak kada' angga'ionna mian. Kasee mian men mansarak mangangga'i Alaata'ala men nomosuu' i ia, mian iya'a kana' a wawauna, ka' sian borek.
Taasi' uga' i Musa a men nantarai i kuu Ukum Torat? Kasee sianta sa'angu'po i kuu men mongololoikon Ukum Torat iya'a. Nongko'upa se' i kuu momoosarak mampapatei i Yaku'?”
Taena i raaya'a taena, “Koo ia lampingi meena! Ime mbali' a men momoosarak ka' mampapatei i Koo?”
Taeni Yesus, “Tongko' sa'angu' palimangon a men Yaku' wawau na ilio Sabat, kuu noko kokoo'anmo.
Musa nambantilkonmo kada' i kuu tio basunat. Bookoi sunat kani'i taasi' ia tadulkon i Musa, kasee ia tadulkon pulinta. Ka' i kuu uga' munsunat mian na ilio Sabat!
Kalu i kuu munsunat mian na ilio Sabat dako' munguluani ukum ni Musa, kadai se' i kuu maso'kon i Yaku' montookon nengelesi'i mian na ilio Sabat?
Alia mungukumi mian tongko' mongololo'kon upa men kampiile'an, kasee ukumi koi men tuutuu'na.”
Tuutuu' mbali' i Yesus Tomundo' Pansalamatkon?
Toro pii samba Yerusalem norobu taena i raaya'a, “Taasi' Iamo kani'i a men sarakon bo papateion?
Ka' piile'! Ia sian bata-bata morobu na aropna mian biai' ka' sianta upa-upa men ia ngaan i raaya'a na Ko'ona. Kabai tanaasta ninginti'imo se' Iamo a Tomundo' Pansalamatkon?
Mian iya'a kita inti'imo a noringkatan-Na, kasee kalu Tomundo' Pansalamatkon taka sianta sa'angu'po a mian minginti'i se' mbaria a noringkatan-Na.”

Tempo i Yesus mimisiso' na Laiganna Alaata'ala, Ia nengeleelo'kon tae-Na, “Tuutuu' mba'a inti'ionmuu se' ime i Yaku' ka' mbaria a noringkatan-Ku. Kada' inti'ionmuu, Yaku' notaka taasi' tongko' pingkira'-Ku, kasee pingkira'na Alaata'ala. Ia Alaata'ala men tuutuu' ka' i Ia a nomosuu' i Yaku'. Kasee i kuu sianta minginti'i i Ia.
Yaku' ninginti'i i Ia, gause i Yaku' ringkat na Ko'ona ka' Iamo a men nomosuu' i Yaku'.”
Raaya'a momoosarak mangarakop i Yesus, kasee sianta sa'angu'po a mian men nongkoyong i Ia, gause tempona koo'po taka.
Kasee na mian biai' iya'a, isian uga' biai' a men noparasaya na Ko'ona ka' norobu taena, “Mian kanooro'o sabole i Tomundo' Pansalamatkon gause biai' tuu' a upa kosamba' men Ia wawaumo.”
Momoosarak mangarakop i Yesus
Mian Farisi nomorongor se' biai' a mian momooseasoikon i Yesus, mbaka' i raaya'a tia tanaasna imam nomosuu'mo dadagai Laiganna Alaata'ala mangarakop i Yesus.

Mbaka' i Yesus norobumo na mian biai' men isian na lalomna Laiganna Alaata'ala tae-Na, “Somo kodi-kodi' i Yaku' dauga'na ruru-ruru' tii kuu ka' moko daa iya'a i Yaku' bo mae' na Ko'ona men nomosuu' i Yaku'.
Kuu bo mansarak i Yaku', kasee sian rumpakionmuu, gause i kuu sian momoko mantaka dodongoan-Ku.”

Kasi moomoola'na Yahudi nopoopikirawari, taena, “Mbaria a rae'an-Na, mbali' se' sian rumpakionta? Kabai i Ia bo mae' na samba Yahudi men na laosalaan, na tanga-tanga'na samba Yunani, bo pimisiso' i raaya'a?
Upa aratina wurung-Na kani'i: Kuu bo mansarak i Yaku', kasee sian rumpakionmuu, ka' i kuu uga' sian momoko mantaka dodongoan-Ku?”
Alus Molinas men nitimbaanikon koi weer men mantarai tutuo' men pore pataka sidutu

Na ilio men kokomburi'anna ramean Sa'up Roon, iliona ramean men tuko, nokumekerermo i Yesus na Laiganna Alaata'ala ka' nengeleelo'kon tae-Na, “Mian men moro'u, porena i ia taka na Ingku' ka' minginum!
Mian men parasaya na Ingku', ia koi men nitulis na Alkitaap taena, ‘Na noana bo umembuar a weer men mantarai tutuo' men pore pataka sidutu.’ ”
Yesus muntundun Alus Molinas men bo labotonna mian men parasaya na Ko'ona. Tempo iya'a Alus Molinas koo'po notaka, gause i Yesus koo'po notonakat mbaara'a na surugaa.
Biai' a mian nomorongor upa men ia tundun i Yesus. Ka' na mian biai' iya'a isian men norobu taena, “Mian kaya'a sabole nabii men bo taka.”
Mian sambana uga' norobu taena, “Ia kani'i Tomundo' Pansalamatkon.” Kasee men sambana uga' norobu taena, “Taasi'. Tomundo' Pansalamatkon taasi' ringkat na Galilea!
Gause isian nitulis na Alkitaap se' i Tomundo' Pansalamatkon iya'a lee' ni Daud ka' ringkat na kampung Betlehem, dodongoan ni Daud mbaripian.”
Mbaka' mian biai' nompoogagaikonmo se' ime i Yesus too i Ia Tomundo' Pansalamatkon kabai taasi'.
Isian men mingkira' mangarakop i Ia, kasee sianta sa'angu'po mian men nongkoyong i Ia.
Nikodemus nuntulungkon i Yesus

Sarataa nomule'kon a dadagai Laiganna Alaata'ala men niposuu' mangarakop i Yesus, tanaasna imam tia mian Farisi iya'a nobapikirawarmo na ko'ona i raaya'a taena, “Nongko'upa i kuu se' sianta nangawawa i Ia?”
Ia simbati dadagai iya'a taena, “Koo'po isian mian men morobu koi i Ia!”
Taena mian Farisi, “Kabai i kuu tinompololo'mo na pisiso'-Na men sala'?
Isian mbali' a tanaasta kabai se' sa'angu'po mian na mian Farisi men mamarasaya i Ia?
Kasee mian biai' karaani'i men sian minginti'i Ukum Torat, bi silaka' i raaya'a!”
Nikodemus, sa'angu' mian Farisi men mbaripian isian notaka ni Yesus, norobu na simbaya'na taena,
“Ukum Toratta mbali' se' mungukum mian, kalu koo'po tia nirongor ka' ni'inti'i se' upa men ia wawau?”
Ia simbati i raaya'a taena, “Kabai i koo uga' samba Galilea? Alaka' piile' na Alkitaap kada' inti'ioon se' sianta nabii men ringkat na Galilea.” Wiwine men nuntumpangkon langkai'na 7:53-8:11 [
